title: Shopping groceries
characterDescription: a comical African Lion eating from a fridge
concept:
I go to the store thinking I’m stocking up for the long haul.
Even if I feel like I’ve done a "big shop," the cupboards are bare again in no time.
Between the heavy lifting and the limited fridge space, there's only so much I can get.
Classic case of underestimating consumption compared to capacity.
